releaseNotes:
Nightify for Android 0.1.5 adds combined YouTube and SoundCloud song search. Matching recordings are deduplicated while live performances and other versions remain separate.

Lyrics from available providers are saved on disk for offline use. Imported files with artist/title tags fetch their lyrics in the background, and downloaded songs prepare lyrics after saving. Lyric caches stay separate for each Nightify account.

Update from **Settings → Updates → Check for updates**. Existing accounts, saved music, playlists and settings are preserved.
